body:
Roster for round 10, next landing after #2663. It records the roster seat's ops since: two groups added (R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-PUSH-PATHS, R10-FLY-INERT-LOAD-TIME), R10-LOOP-CPU set to done at the #2632 merge, R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF started ahead of its after-edge by the orchestrator's ruling, and carries appended to R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2, R10-FLY-OPENPR-ATOMIC and R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-EMITTERS. Part of #201. It closes nothing by keyword and leaves #201 open.

## Head

`5d874ec6309675a391f1a97acf6e5a77781d3f78` merges origin/main `12032c43c` (an automatic merge by the orchestrator's script; any resolution inside the code head is described below) into this PR's previous head, and then adds one commit containing only this PR's own row, `dev/programme/delivery/2667.md`.

`7dc4f2f0feba0c6b24a32c4f3d10374e3c36a87a` merges `origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` (`3b4b615e00a194a95d27c12d7ff7538225db0f03`) into `origin/main` `12032c43cc321160ab0278f417c9575b786a03b4` (the #2663 merge); the merge was clean. The authored code head is `3b4b615e0`, the tip of `handoff/audit-r10-roster`. Its merge base with `origin/main` is `09b7c7635c031ca3065b05bf99babbcb2cd1e365`, the roster head #2663 carried. The diff against `origin/main` is one file, `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json`, 104 insertions and 8 deletions (`git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` prints them) over 21 commits (`git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` prints 21), each one `roster_edit.py` op.

## Mutation proof

n/a: roster state only; no production or test code.

## Null control

`git diff --exit-code 09b7c7635c031ca3065b05bf99babbcb2cd1e365 12032c43cc321160ab0278f417c9575b786a03b4 -- dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` has rc 0: the roster on main equals the merge base, so nothing main wrote since is overwritten. The `removed` list below is empty.

## Figures

The 21 ops, by roster SHA (`git log --reverse --format='%h %s' origin/main..origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` prints them): `c8bcafb1b`, `cc209fdd9`, `59fa6da8a` set-resume and set-stage R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF to in-progress; `ac6546161` append-carry R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-EMITTERS; `75e1b489c` append-group R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-PUSH-PATHS and `fd568a454`, `6a5230987`, `3c7213da2`, `56bf50f77` its resume fields and stage; `1d9600109`, `1b4ca4d22`, `01177c96d`, `c9c56c337`, `e5fdf08cc` five append-carry ops on R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2; `036cb0a3c` append-carry R10-FLY-OPENPR-ATOMIC; `fe004a285` append-group R10-FLY-INERT-LOAD-TIME and `f9d3e5579`, `790b48f5b`, `a1b21915d`, `4a9965e7c` its branch, next step, brief citation and stage; `3b4b615e0` set-stage R10-LOOP-CPU done at `7108101d71211772c2f45f67b240ee3663e3446e` (#2632).

Measured with `B=origin/main`, `H=origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster`, `R=dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json`: `jq -n --slurpfile b <(git show $B:$R) --slurpfile h <(git show $H:$R) '($b[0].groups|map({(.group):.})|add) as $B|($h[0].groups|map({(.group):.})|add) as $H|{nb:($B|length),nh:($H|length),removed:[$B|keys[]|select($H[.]==null)],new:[$H|keys[]|select($B[.]==null)],changed:[$H|keys[]|select($B[.]!=null and $B[.]!=$H[.])]}'` prints 169 and 171 groups, none removed, 2 new (R10-FLY-INERT-LOAD-TIME, R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-PUSH-PATHS) and 5 changed (R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2, R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-EMITTERS, R10-FLY-OPENPR-ATOMIC, R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF, R10-LOOP-CPU). Groups by `resume.stage`, main then this head: done 95 then 96, in-progress 6 then 8, not-started 61 then 60, queued 6 then 6, absorbed 1 then 1. `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` on the merged head prints `TOTAL: 0 error(s) across 1 file(s)`, and `python3 tools/audit/seat/ref_privacy.py --check` there prints `0 refused`. The scoped gate (`GATE_SCOPE=auto GOLDEN_MODE=drift GOLDEN_REF=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) ./tests/run.sh`, `PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1`) printed `MODE: SCOPED -- 1 script(s) run, 32 scoped out.` and `5 TEST SCRIPT(S) PASSED`.
